chunks: From him, from Ibn Mahbub, from Amr bin Shamar, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever among you meets our Qaim, let him say when he sees him: Peace be upon you, O Ahl al-Bayt of prophethood, mine of knowledge, and place of messengership.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended greeting for meeting the Mahdi (al-Qaim)?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) prescribes a specific greeting for the era of the Major Occultation, highlighting the Ahl al-Bayt as the 'source of knowledge' and 'place of the message.' This salutation underscores the theological continuity between the Prophets and the Imams, affirming the latter as the living custodians of divine revelation and wisdom.
